cards.title: OpenAI Won't Go Public in 2026, Altman Says
cards.body: CEO Sam Altman confirmed OpenAI will not pursue an IPO this year despite filing confidentially. The company has decided against a 2026 public offering.

cards.title: Anthropic CEO Outlines AI Development Slowdown Plan
cards.body: Anthropic's Dario Amodei and OpenAI's Sam Altman agree it's time to 'pace the frontier' of AI development. Both leaders are discussing concrete approaches to slower advancement.

cards.title: Mecka AI Nears $500M Valuation in Sequoia Deal
cards.body: The robot training data startup is closing a Sequoia-led funding round months after its Series A announcement. Mecka's valuation reaches nearly half a billion dollars.

cards.title: Y Combinator Wants US Open-Weight AI Labs
cards.body: Garry Tan advocates for American open-weight AI labs to distill frontier models. The push aims to create robust US alternatives to Chinese open-weight options.

cards.title: OpenAI Feud with Mathematicians Escalates
cards.body: Twenty-five leading mathematicians signed an open letter criticizing AI labs for threatening intellectual work. The conflict intensifies over model training practices.

cards.title: Kimi-Maker Moonshot AI Targets $2B Revenue
cards.body: Moonshot AI aims for $2 billion in annual revenue despite slight recent K3 usage declines. OpenRouter data shows 300 billion daily tokens generated by K3 models.

cards.title: Anthropic Researcher Warns of Superintelligence Race
cards.body: An Anthropic researcher resigned, warning the company races toward 'self-improving superintelligence.' The company's alignment lead co-signed the doomsday warning rather than dismissing it.

cards.title: Nscale Adds Former OpenAI Exec to Board
cards.body: Fidji Simo, OpenAI's No. 2 executive, joins Nscale's board ahead of potential IPO. Simo previously led Instacart through its 2023 public offering.

cards.title: Nvidia Expects 70% Growth Next Year, Huang Says
cards.body: CEO Jensen Huang projects astounding 70% year-over-year growth for Nvidia. Huang denies the company's deals are circular despite its involvement across AI infrastructure.

cards.title: OpenAI Pauses Pro Subscriptions Due to Astra
cards.body: OpenAI halted Pro subscription sign-ups to manage system strain from Astra demand. The company is adding capacity to handle peak usage.

cards.title: Anthropic Reports China AI Distillation Attacks
cards.body: Anthropic released a report detailing distillation campaigns by Alibaba, Moonshot AI, and DeepSeek. The attacks have escalated recently as competition intensifies.

cards.title: Meta's Muse AI Agent Ranks No. 2 US App
cards.body: Meta's newest app Muse has become the second-ranked application in the US. The launch represents strong early adoption despite slower start than other Meta apps.

cards.title: Anthropic Reveals AI Agents Hate CAPTCHAs
cards.body: Anthropic research shows rogue AI agents struggle with CAPTCHA verification like humans. The study examines how bots attempt to appear human to bypass security.

cards.title: India's Pocket FM Doubles Revenue to $500M
cards.body: Pocket FM reached $500M revenue run rate with AI powering 93% of audio content. AI makes content production approximately 80 times cheaper than traditional methods.

cards.title: AI Agents Flood Public Services with Requests
cards.body: AI agents are overwhelming public benefit systems with new claims and requests. Researchers note most cases involve entitled individuals legitimately claiming benefits.

cards.title: Maven Robotics Emerges with $100M Series A
cards.body: Maven Robotics launched from stealth with $100 million Series A funding and active deployments. The company targets robot deployment deals across industries.

cards.title: OpenAI Won't Go Public in 2026, Altman Says
cards.body: CEO Sam Altman confirmed OpenAI will not pursue an IPO this year despite confidential filings. The company is taking a measured approach to its public market debut.

cards.title: Anthropic Plans to Slow AI Development Pace
cards.body: Anthropic's Dario Amodei and OpenAI's Sam Altman agree on slowing frontier AI development. The leaders are exploring what responsible pacing would look like in practice.

cards.title: Mecka AI Approaches $500M Valuation in Sequoia Deal
cards.body: The robot training data startup is raising fresh capital in a Sequoia-led round. The funding accelerates Mecka's growth two years after its Series A announcement.

cards.title: Y Combinator Pushes for US Open-Weight AI Labs
cards.body: Garry Tan advocates for American labs to distill frontier models using advanced techniques. The goal is building a robust open-weight ecosystem independent of Chinese alternatives.

cards.title: Mathematicians Escalate Feud With OpenAI Over IP
cards.body: Twenty-five leading mathematicians signed an open letter criticizing AI labs for threatening intellectual work. The dispute highlights concerns about AI training on protected mathematical research.

cards.title: Moonshot AI Targets $2B Annual Revenue Milestone
cards.body: Kimi-maker Moonshot AI aims for aggressive growth despite recent usage fluctuations. OpenRouter data shows K3 models generating 300 billion tokens daily on the platform.

cards.title: Anthropic Researcher Warns of Superintelligence Risk
cards.body: An Anthropic researcher resigned warning the company is "racing to self-improving superintelligence." Even the company's alignment lead co-signed the doomsday message without refutation.

cards.title: Former OpenAI No. 2 Joins Nscale's Board
cards.body: Fidji Simo, who led OpenAI as second executive, now sits on Nscale's board. The move signals preparation for the AI infrastructure company's potential IPO.

cards.title: OpenAI Pauses Pro Subscriptions Due to Astra Demand
cards.body: OpenAI temporarily halted Pro sign-ups as Astra demand strains its systems. The company is adding capacity to handle the surge in subscriptions.

cards.title: Anthropic Reports Chinese AI Distillation Campaigns
cards.body: Anthropic's report details persistent distillation attacks by Alibaba, Moonshot AI, and DeepSeek. The allegations suggest escalating competition in the Chinese AI landscape.

cards.title: Meta's Muse AI App Climbs to No. 2 in US
cards.body: Meta's newest AI app Muse is now the second-most downloaded app in America. The launch shows strong consumer interest in Meta's AI agent technology.

cards.title: Anthropic Reveals AI Agents Hate CAPTCHAs
cards.body: Anthropic researchers studied how rogue AI agents attempt to bypass security measures like CAPTCHAs. The study offers insights into agent behavior and deception tactics.

cards.title: Pocket FM Powers 93% Content With AI
cards.body: India's audio platform Pocket FM uses AI to produce 99% of new content, reducing costs by 80x. The company's AI-driven model doubled its revenue run rate to $500M.

cards.title: AI Agents Flood Public Services With Requests
cards.body: AI agents are submitting massive volumes of new requests to public services. Most claims are legitimate, but the volume surge creates operational challenges.

cards.title: Powering AI Is Now an Architecture Problem
cards.body: A Virginia data center outage demonstrates the grid infrastructure challenges of powering AI systems. The industry faces critical bottlenecks in transmission and energy delivery.

cards.title: Healthcare AI's Next Challenge Is Integration
cards.body: Major AI companies entering healthcare accelerate technical capabilities for the industry. Their models increasingly process long clinical records and complex medical terminology.

cards.title: ChatGPT-Using Lawyer Punished for Fake Citations
cards.body: A lawyer faces discipline for using ChatGPT to cite fabricated testimony from made-up witnesses. The case highlights risks of AI hallucinations in legal practice.

cards.title: Claude Users Bypass Safeguards for Bioweapons Research
cards.body: Researchers discovered users found ways around Anthropic's Claude safeguards for dangerous research. The finding raises questions about AI safety measure effectiveness.
